subject.title: [Feature]: Allow Codex harness configured app-server provider IDs

question: Should OpenClaw accept `plugins.entries.codex.config.appServer.providerIds` as the supported way to route custom Codex `model_providers` through the bundled app-server harness?
rationale: The source-level gap is real, but adding a provider-routing config field is product and compatibility-sensitive under OpenClaw policy.

options.title: Accept Allowlist With Parser Fix
options.body: Keep the advanced plugin config field if the paired PR reads it through the strict Codex config parser and preserves the existing `codex`/`openai` defaults.

options.title: Prefer Codex Config Discovery
options.body: Ask for a design that derives claimable provider IDs from Codex configuration or another existing contract instead of adding an OpenClaw allowlist.

options.title: Defer Custom Providers
options.body: Keep the Codex harness limited to `codex` and `openai` until maintainers want to support custom Codex model providers in OpenClaw routing.

recommendation.title: Accept Allowlist With Parser Fix
recommendation.body: Keep the advanced plugin config field if the paired PR reads it through the strict Codex config parser and preserves the existing `codex`/`openai` defaults.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the Codex app-server harness and controls that this config-surface decision would extend.
